_explanation.increments: Organize stories into increments prioritized by risk and value. Each increment should be a vertical slice delivering end-to-end working flow. Priority 1 = NOW (current increment), Priority 2 = NEXT, Priority 3 = LATER.
_explanation.epic_distribution: Epics and sub_epics can span multiple increments. Show partial completion using estimated_stories (e.g., Epic has 10 total stories: Increment 1 delivers 3, Increment 2 delivers 4, Increment 3 delivers remaining 3).
_explanation.architectural_risk: Prioritize stories that validate architectural risks, test integrations, or prove technology choices in early increments (Priority 1). Defer nice-to-have features to later increments.
